title: 1947 National Security Act and Majestic 12
summary: Dylan Borland tells of 1947 National Security Act and Majestic 12, about 1947 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It it is. And then you get into the 1947 National Security Act with creating the Air Force, the CIA, the National Security Council, which you and I discussed, which is how much was Majestic 12 tied into National Security Council.

plain: A researcher, Dylan Borland, points to the National Security Act of 1947, the US law that created the Air Force, the CIA spy agency and the National Security Council, the president's top security body. He raises the question of how closely Majestic 12, a group some say was secretly set up to handle recovered alien craft, was tied into that council. If true, it would mean the secrecy around such craft was built into the government's security system from the start.
